withdrawn.title: The 70% claim
withdrawn.what: A directional-accuracy claim was only allowed to stand if it cleared a threshold written down before the measurement. On 5,325 committed calls it measures 0.703 against a declared gate of 0.7178, so the claim stays withdrawn. The full ledger stays public.

withdrawn.title: An exam lane I could not certify

products.name: Forecasting
products.one: Turns a history into a tested forecast and a reviewed decision. Every step leaves a receipt.
products.line: Models race on the past, a written rule picks the winner, ranges must pass a test or are withheld, outside signals must beat chance, and a person approves before anything is issued.
products.problem: Forecasts usually arrive as one confident number, with no way to see how it was picked or whether its ranges hold.
products.plan: Make every step checkable: rules written down before the results, a simple baseline the model has to beat, and a person who approves.
